summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would allow workers who move into a high-risk job to have their life insurance policy separated from their superannuation account.
It would amend the Superannuation Guarantee (Administration) Act to 'unstaple' the superannuation policy when a worker transfers to a 'dangerous occupation'.
A 'dangerous occupation' is defined as one where the workplace death rate exceeds 2.5 per 100,000 workers each year.
changes: The bill would 'unstaple' life insurance policies from superannuation accounts when workers move to a dangerous occupation.
It would define a dangerous occupation by a workplace death rate threshold of more than 2.5 per 100,000 workers per year.
It would ensure workers have suitable life insurance coverage immediately upon starting a new high-risk job.
summary.affected: Workers who transfer employment into a dangerous occupation are affected.
